description: The Fukushima Prefectural Center for Environmental Creation supplies suspended 134Cs and 137Cs concentrations through the University of Tsukuba's ERAN repository. Its own page identifies 28 river monitoring sites within 80 km of Fukushima Daiichi and coverage from April 2015 to March 2017. Suspended-solid samples were collected every few months, averaging 62 days, dried and measured with a germanium detector. Values are decay-corrected to the collection date. A delimited file is freely available under CC BY 4.0. The series can calibrate post-accident sediment-contamination transport or test exposure assumptions for downstream water infrastructure, including transport simulations using model-openfoam. A caveat is that intermittent suspended-solid samples do not resolve every high-flow event and cannot be equated with treated-water concentrations. The landing page directs readers elsewhere for older data, so continuous coverage back to 2011 is not claimed for this deposit. No individual observations were downloaded.
